Our route for this half-day tour weaves through the hills and lush forests around Nandi. We have curated rides of difficulty different levels in the region. The level-1 ride charts out a fairly easy route through some flat terrain while still touching upon several scenic spots. The climbs in the level-2 and level-3 route variations in this region are challenging, with some exhilarating descents. You will experience riding on quiet traffic-free forest and village roads, that run beside a couple of pristine lakes and dams. All the joys of bicycle touring wrapped into a few hours of riding.

Itinerary

  • Meeting Time: 5:45 am
  • Meeting Point: Silver Oak Cafe, near Nandi base
  • We will do a rental bike allotment & basic fit, followed by a ride briefing before we start the ride
  • Ride Options available (these could vary depending on what is scheduled on the particular date, please check while booking):
    • Level-1 ride: Distance 29 km | Cumulative Elevation Gain 200 m
    • Level-2 ride: Distance 50 km | Cumulative Elevation Gain 500 m
    • Level-3 ride: Distance 100 km | Cumulative Elevation Gain 1000 m

What do the levels mean?

The Level 1 (Beginner) rides are ideal for those who want to get back into cycling after a long time and get a taste of bicycle touring. The Level-2 (Moderate) rides are intended for those who've done a few of our Level-1 rides (20-30 km). The Level-3 (Challenging) rides are suitable for those who've done some Level-2 rides (40-60 km) and want to take it up a notch. Level-4 (Extreme) are rides and tours which have a lot of difficult climbs and or difficult conditions like in high-altitude regions.

FAQs

What's included in this tour?
  • Curated cycling and travel experience
  • Logistics planning
  • Ride refreshments (electrolytes/energy tabs)
  • Mechanical support
  • First aid & emergency management 

What's not included in this tour?
  • Rental bike (available as an add-on)
  • Breakfast & Lunch, unless specified in the booking options
  • Personal expenses
  • People transportation to the starting point and back (carpooling will be facilitated)

Cancellation & Refund Policy
- No refund in case of a NO SHOW.
- No refund on cancellations done less than 24 hrs prior to the start of the event.
- 50% refund or tour credits on cancellations done 1 to 7 days from the start of the event.
- 100% refund or tour credits on cancellations done more than 7 days from the start of the event.
